conditions.v: childhood lead exposure (elevated blood lead level)

ev.q: Childhood Lead Exposure Linked to Apple Cinnamon Fruit Puree Pouches — North Carolina, June 2023–January 2024
Investigations identified WanaBana Apple Cinnamon Fruit Puree pouches as the likely exposure source.
All blood lead test results for children aged <6 years are reportable to the North Carolina Department of Health and Human Services (NCDHHS)
On a food log, the parents recalled that both siblings ate WanaBana fruit puree pouches.

notes: Case series nested in an outbreak investigation; the table sets characteristics of confirmed, probable and suspected cases side by side with no claim resting on that contrast, so read as limited. The ~500/519 nationwide cases are cited from CDC/FDA reports. Product lead levels judged against North Carolina's reportable limit are case-finding steps, not comparisons.
